# anthropic_vault (Resource)

Manages a Managed Agents vault: a container for credentials (`anthropic_vault_credential`) that agents and deployments use at run time.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

~> With `delete_on_destroy = true` (the default) destroy hard-deletes the vault and every credential in it. Set it to `false` to archive instead (secrets are purged, records kept).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_vault" "ci" {
  display_name = "CI credentials"
  metadata = {
    team = "platform"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name, 1 to 255 characters. Not unique.

### Optional

- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) Hard-delete on destroy (default `true`). `false` archives the vault instead.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Key/value metadata (up to 16 pairs).

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Vault id (`vlt_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_vault.ci vlt_01ExampleVaultId000000000
```
